description: This source file defines an Android Fragment class 'BatchStepSensorFragment' that manages step counter and step detector sensors, handles sensor events to count steps, updates UI cards, manages sensor registration and unregistration, and handles user interactions within a sensor-based step counting app.

classes.name: BatchStepSensorFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment managing step sensor interactions and UI cards for sensor status, step counting, and user actions.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Initializes cards and checks device support when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters sensor listeners when the fragment pauses.

methods.name: isKitkatWithStepSensor
methods.description: Checks if the device supports step sensors and is running Android KitKat or higher.

methods.name: onCardClick
methods.description: Handles user actions on cards, such as registering/unregistering sensors, dismissing info cards.

methods.name: registerEventListener
methods.description: Registers a sensor event listener with specified batch delay and sensor type.

methods.name: resetCounter
methods.description: Resets step counting variables and data structures.

methods.name: recordDelay
methods.description: Records delay times of sensor events for display.

methods.name: getDelayString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing recorded sensor event delays.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves fragment state for restoration during configuration changes.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Restores fragment state and re-registers sensors if needed.

methods.name: showCountingCards
methods.description: Displays the step counting UI cards.

methods.name: showErrorCard
methods.description: Displays error message if device sensors are unsupported.

methods.name: initialiseCards
methods.description: Creates and adds various UI cards for app interaction and info display.

methods.name: getCardStream
methods.description: Retrieves the CardStreamFragment instance used for managing UI cards.
